The scenario: employer (谭某某) without construction qualification, fails to ensure safety measures (no helmets, safety rope), leading to worker falling from scaffolding and dying. This is a major responsibility accident (重大责任事故) as per Chinese criminal law: causing death due to safety negligence in production safety, under Article 133 (or 132?) of Criminal Law: "重大责任事故罪" (major responsibility accident).
